migration_mode.reason: bounded post-migration dual-runner expansion; exclusive resource claims remain authoritative and atomic

derivation.rule: each runner class resolves its execution contract -> resource_class; gpu_uuids become atomic exclusive resource claims
derivation.atomicity: all required exclusive resources are reserved together or none are reserved

reservation_policy.allocation_order: first successful atomic RESERVE; no persistent wait queue in migration v1
reservation_policy.busy_semantics: BUSY is capacity-local and creates no JIT registration
reservation_policy.starvation_note: host_max_active_runners=2 permits bounded concurrency while atomic exclusive GPU claims prevent device overlap; fairness remains first-successful RESERVE

release_policy.normal: release after runner terminal and containment cleanup proof
release_policy.cancel_before_launch: release on typed CANCEL or reservation expiry
release_policy.launch_failure: release only after deterministic unit/JIT cleanup is proven
release_policy.cleanup_failure: do not release ambiguous scarce resources; quarantine exact runner class and require maintenance

invariants: root resource allocator is the only component allowed to grant physical GPU claims
CPU-only class has an empty GPU claim set
catalog/resource-policy generation is bound into runner-instance receipts
host concurrency is capped at two; only padataset is raised to two project-active runners in this candidate
raising concurrency never weakens exclusive GPU claims or permits two active records to reserve the same GPU resource
